title: New Orleans Will Use AI To Answer 911 Calls Instead of a Human - Slashdot
excerpt: "If you call 911 in New Orleans, you may hear the sound of an artificial intelligence (AI) agent answering your call instead of a human voice," reports the Shreveport Times: The Orleans Parish Communication District (OPCD) is currently testing out the new tool designed to reduce the volume of calls...
content_html:
"If you call 911 in New Orleans, you may hear the sound of an artificial intelligence (AI) agent answering your call instead of a human voice," reports the Shreveport Times: The Orleans Parish Communication District (OPCD) is currently testing out the new tool designed to reduce the volume of calls human dispatchers must handle, which is over a thousand emergency calls a day. New Orleans implemented AI in April to answer 311 calls for non-emergencies. The AI was trained and programmed to provide information to callers, as the OPCD says 50% of 311 calls are for information, according to GovTech. AI is now answering 911 emergency calls in Louisiana's largest city and one of the cities with the highest call rates in the U.S.

The OPCD is using Carbyne's AI Emergency Call Triage, with triage being the process of analyzing and prioritizing emergency calls. The AI system assesses incoming calls and can provide immediate feedback to callers. This is intended to handle the increase of calls that are related to one incident, so callers get automatically routed to an AI agent who asks if they are calling regarding the incident. If the answer is yes, then callers can receive information or updates, and if it's no, then the callers are transferred to a human. This combats multitudes of calls piling up and taking longer time to potentially answer an emergency call. The OPCD said the AI will not be used to handle emergency calls, only to direct such calls to a human dispatcher.

sentences.zh: 人工智能系统评估来电，并可以向呼叫者提供即时反馈。

sentences.en: If the answer is yes, then callers can receive information or updates, and if it's no, then the callers are transferred to a human.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，那么呼叫者就可以接收信息或更新，如果答案是否定的，那么呼叫者就会被转接给人工接听。

content_html_zh: 据《什里夫波特时报》报道：“如果您在新奥尔良拨打 911，您可能会听到人工智能 (AI) 代理接听电话的声音，而不是人类的声音。”奥尔良教区通讯区 (OPCD) 目前正在测试新工具，旨在减少人工调度员必须处理的呼叫量，每天有超过 1000 个紧急呼叫。 新奥尔良于 4 月份实施了人工智能来接听非紧急情况的 311 电话。 据 GovTech 称，人工智能经过培训和编程，可以向呼叫者提供信息，正如 OPCD 所说，311 个呼叫中有 50% 是为了获取信息。 AI 现在正在路易斯安那州最大的城市和美国呼叫率最高的城市之一接听 911 紧急呼叫。OPCD 正在使用 Carbyne 的 AI 紧急呼叫分类，分类是对紧急呼叫进行分析和优先级排序的过程。 人工智能系统评估来电，并可以向呼叫者提供即时反馈。 这样做的目的是为了处理与某一事件相关的呼叫增加，因此呼叫者会自动路由到人工智能代理，该代理会询问他们是否正在就该事件拨打电话。 如果答案是肯定的，那么呼叫者就可以接收信息或更新，如果答案是否定的，那么呼叫者就会被转接给人工接听。 这可以防止大量呼叫堆积以及需要更长的时间来应答紧急呼叫。 OPCD 表示，人工智能不会用于处理紧急呼叫，只会将此类呼叫转给人工调度员。
